Retain bounded phase, exit status, output directory and actual stdout/stderr for failed Word validation, creation and formatting; keep partial output blocked without an artifact.

Accept one nonempty pre-body Markdown contents section and metadata-matched bilingual front titles without changing the final reviewed source; preserve source explanations in consecutive appendices and reject unknown top-level headings.
Publish Cloud and Desktop targets; require exact integer page inspection coverage from the actual renderer count, reject nonzero render exits and retain current Word artifact/version binding.

Keep fixed display-equation table grids, total width and cell widths consistent so native OMML uses the declared 146 mm equation column instead of the default one-third grid; retain all reviewed math content, equation numbers and following prose. Apply the same width calibration when formatting existing marker-free numbered OMML tables, preserving ordinary data tables and saving a separate repaired document.
Accept dataset DS and DS/OL markers in reference JSON and final DOCX validation, retaining mandatory online citation dates and URLs, continuous final numbering and existing document types.

Embed checked local PNG/JPEG and static SVG Markdown figures as Word media, resolve material paths within the current workspace, retain one figure caption, and block missing, invalid, remote or escaping images.
Preserve reviewed Markdown subsection numbers, names and heading levels in Word and its catalog, without adding numbering to unnumbered headings or interpreting numeric prose as headings or lists.
Honor paragraph line spacing without snapping to the legacy document grid, and require a working LibreOffice Math component before rendering native Word equations.
Use the final reviewed report as the Word content source, preserve bilingual abstracts, references and Markdown tables, and reject unreadable final sources instead of using earlier chapter snapshots.
